title: Thermal-model page offers house thermal mass on a two-zone house, where no model reads it
claim: On a two-zone entry (the default install: two_zone_mode auto resolves on), the thermal_model options page renders and saves house_thermal_mass, but changing it to 40 kWh/K moves no planned step, while the same change on a single-zone entry moves the plan: 1 of the 8 fields the two-zone page renders is inert there and effective on one zone.
mechanism: house_thermal_mass maps to ThermalParameters.room_thermal_mass, read only by the single-zone dynamics (thermal_model.py simulate single-zone branch and envelope_thermal_mass's else-branch); two zones read upper/lower_floor_thermal_mass. Its sibling house_heat_loss_coefficient is gated when=_single_zone (R10-TWO-ZONE-HHL); this row has no gate, and its description ('In a floor-heated house the heavy floor and heated slab are counted separately ...') tells a floor-heated two-zone user it applies.

evidence.unit: thermal_model page fields rendered on a two-zone entry that move no plan there while moving it on a single-zone entry

perturbation.change: --perturb-gate: give the house_thermal_mass _F row when=_single_zone in config_flow._OPTION_FIELDS

metric_definition: count of thermal_model fields rendered for two_zone_mode=on whose change leaves the plan byte-identical there but moves it for two_zone_mode=off (RESULT two_zone_only_no_effect)
phenomenon_property: An options-page field is rendered only in the topologies whose model reads it; on any other it is hidden (or made to take effect).
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D17/s1/h_zone.py (every field the thermal_model page renders, per zone mode)

null_control.note: the field works where the single-zone model reads it

reproduction_steps: fresh entry (two-zone by default); Options > Advanced > Thermal model; set House thermal mass 40; save
proposed_fix_scope: config_flow._OPTION_FIELDS: gate CONF_HOUSE_THERMAL_MASS when=_single_zone like the heat-loss row, and say in its strings.json description that a two-zone house sets the zone masses on the Two-zone model page (or make the two-zone model read it).
